lines.native: Ciao! Sono Flick. Hai un minuto? Just one more. Riddle me—oh, a leaf! Aspetta, per favore!
lines.translation: Hi! I'm Flick. Do you have a minute? Just one more. Riddle me—oh, a leaf! Wait, please!
lines.narrative: The Cracked Fountain drips with municipal confidence. Flick flickers at the edge of your vision; a tiny firecracker pops where he ought to be.

lines.native: Guardo! Che cosa? Una foglia? You got me looking, not stopping. Attention span: scenic route. Corro ancora! Come mi fai smettere? Riddle me—wait, that dust is leaving.
lines.translation: I'm looking! At what? A leaf? You got me looking, not stopping. Attention span: scenic route. I'm still running! How do you make me stop? Riddle me—wait, that dust is leaving.
lines.narrative: Flick follows your gaze, then follows a speck of dust which appears to have firmer plans. A tiny firecracker pops at the edge of your vision.

lines.native: Va bene, mi fermo! Non corro più. Attention span: surprisingly powerful. Dove devo andare? Un indovinello: dove va una foglia quando—oh, another leaf. Possiamo partire domani?
lines.translation: All right, I’m stopping! I’m not running anymore. Attention span: surprisingly powerful. Where should I go? A riddle: where does a leaf go when—oh, another leaf. Can we leave tomorrow?
lines.narrative: Flick stops at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker continues without him, having received no instructions.

lines.native: In inglese? No, mi serve una direzione in italiano! Dove devo andare? Riddle me—actually, five more minutes. Una pausa, per favore? My attention span needs a loading screen.
lines.translation: In English? No, I need a direction in Italian! Where should I go? Riddle me—actually, five more minutes. A break, please? My attention span needs a loading screen.
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains in the corner of your vision, where accountability has poor reception.

lines.native: A sinistra, sì! Va bene! But moving is a whole commitment. Possiamo partire domani? Ho una domanda: perché una foglia—oh, just one more leaf.
lines.translation: To the left, yes! All right! But moving is a whole commitment. Can we leave tomorrow? I have a question: why does a leaf—oh, just one more leaf.
lines.narrative: Flick drifts left at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker announces that this counts as progress, pending further delay.

lines.native: Domani? Sì, perfetto! Ma vuoi partire o aspettare? Decidi tu! Just five more minutes. Un indovinello: perché partire quando—oh, una foglia!
lines.translation: Tomorrow? Yes, perfect! But do you want to leave or wait? You decide! Just five more minutes. A riddle: why leave when—oh, a leaf!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops just outside your field of vision. Flick has accepted tomorrow with the enthusiasm of someone who has never visited it.

lines.native: Adesso? Va bene, partiamo adesso! Vado a sinistra. Hai vinto! Attention span: terrifying. Un indovinello: perché aspettare quando—no, questo dopo. Just one more step.
lines.translation: Now? All right, let's leave now! I'm going left. You won! Attention span: terrifying. A riddle: why wait when—no, that comes later. Just one more step.
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick is already at the left-hand door, visibly offended by the present tense.
